calibration: After the first live run (52/68), three checks were loosened. The reasons are about the text, not about what the model output:
Priya's neutral 'proposed' is optional: she lists two options without taking a side, so no one is wrong to omit it.
Jun's note raises a concern and asks for time; 'oppose' or 'conditional' are both fair readings of 'before anyone commits to A'.
Open objections/blockers may be 1-2: Tom's 'I do not have capacity' (a reason against B) and Dev's unanswered request for the build cost are borderline items a careful reader could file or not.
Blocker owners are no longer scored as a hard check: blockers have no owner field in the data model.
scenario_notes: Linear reply-all chain. Jun's private note (m5, sent to Priya only) is quoted to everyone when Priya replies all (m6). Only one explicit supporter of A, so there is no directional preference.
